extracted.intended_audience: Applicants for NIH K99/R00 Career Development (PHS 398) and institutional grant administrators preparing budgets and supplements
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the NIH K99/R00 (PHS 398) career development grant application, including Research & Related budgets, budget justification, and required supplemental forms and responses to reviewer comments. Covers personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, indirect costs, and PHS 398 supplemental sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification file attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: L. Budget Justification* — File Name: Budget Justification.pdf (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only a single Budget Justification file may be attached. Ensure all justification material is consolidated into that one file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment Description — List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each equipment item with cost > $5,000, provide item description and dollar amount and include a cumulative 'Total Equipment' line and any attached equipment file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect costs: MTDC and K-award allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect costs are calculated on an MTDC base pursuant to K award allowance of 8%. Indirect Cost Type: 1. MTDC; Indirect Cost Rate (%); Indirect Cost Base ($); Total Indirect Costs; Cognizant Federal Agency (DHHS, contact information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Modified Total Direct Cost (MTDC) base for indirect cost calculation. For K awards, apply the K-award allowance (8%) unless institutional policy or sponsor instructions override. Provide cognizant federal agency and POC details as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budgeting and effort reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Section A — Senior/Key Person: collect Prefix, First/Middle/Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report each senior/key person's calendar effort (in months), salary requested, and fringe. Aggregate 'Total Senior/Key Person' funds and attach any additional senior/key person file if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fringe benefit rates and salary escalation
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification: 'fringe benefits are calculated pursuant to Weill Cornell Medicine’s institutional policy of 29.5% of salary for all faculty and staff and 23% for post docs. Salaries reflect a 3% annual increase.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply institution-specified fringe benefit rates (or those required by your institution). Project expected annual salary escalation (3% in this application) and document the assumptions in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other personnel categories and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Section B — Other Personnel: list personnel categories (Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Research Assistant), number of personnel, calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary ($), fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify counts and effort for each category, include fringe calculations, and total 'Total Number Other Personnel' and 'Total Other Personnel' fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel cost categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Section D — Travel: 1. Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) 2. Foreign Travel Costs; report Funds Requested ($) for each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel line items and provide justification and totals in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee support cost elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Section E — Participant/Trainee Support Costs: 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; 2. Stipends; 3. Travel; 4. Subsistence; 5. Other; plus Number of Participants/Trainees and Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When requesting participant support, itemize each applicable category, provide number of participants/trainees, and include supporting justification (e.g., how amounts were determined) in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs line-itemization
rubrics_metrics.description: Section F — Other Direct Costs includes: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; 8. Other Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize each 'other direct cost' with amounts and brief descriptions in the Budget Justification and include totals for 'Total Other Direct Costs' and 'Total Direct Costs (A thru F)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subawards/Consortium/Contractual designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Type*: ● Project ❍ Subaward/Consortium and fields for Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs under Section F.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the submission is a project or contains subaward/consortium components. If subawards are included, provide detailed budget and justification for each consortium/subaward component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute total direct, indirect, fee, and total costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections G, H, I, J, K — G. Direct Costs; H. Indirect Costs; I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs (G + H); J. Fee; K. Total Costs and Fee (I + J).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate arithmetic linking of section totals (A-F → G; H calculated from MTDC → I = G+H; add fee if applicable). Document assumptions for fee and any institutional cost sharing in the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget totals and line-item reconciliation
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget - Cumulative Budget: provide Totals ($) for Section A (Senior/Key Person), Section B (Other Personnel), Total Salary/Wages/Fringe (A+B), Section C (Equipment), Section D (Travel) [Domestic and Foreign], Section E (Participant/Trainee Support Costs), Section F (Other Direct Costs lines 1–10), Section G (Direct Costs), Section H (Indirect Costs), Section I (Total Direct and Indirect Costs), Section J (Fee), Section K (Total Costs and Fee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure cumulative budget reconciles with per-period budgets and that all line-item totals are presented and explained.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Vertebrate Animals Section (euthanasia compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — 1. Vertebrate Animals Section: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? Yes/No. If 'Yes' to euthanasia, Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If vertebrate animals are used, explicitly state euthanasia practices and compliance with AVMA; provide justification and methods if not consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — 2. Program Income Section: Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? Yes/No. If 'Yes', use the provided format to reflect the amount and source(s); otherwise leave blank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare anticipated program income and itemize amounts and sources for each budget period if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human embryonic stem cell compliance and registry reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — 3. Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? Yes/No. If yes, list registration number(s) from NIH registry or check box that one from the registry will be used if specific line cannot be referenced at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If hESCs are used, provide registry numbers or a plan to use a registry-listed line and include documentation per NIH stem cell policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and patents reporting for renewal applications
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — 4. Inventions and Patents Section (Renewal applications): *Inventions and Patents: Yes/No. If 'Yes' then indicate *Previously Reported: Yes/No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal applications, disclose inventions and patent activity and whether they were previously reported to NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — 5. Change of Investigator/Change of Institution Section: provide Name of former Project Director/Principal Investigator (prefix, first, middle, last, suffix) and Name of former institution if indicating change of PD/PI or grantee institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a change of PD/PI or institution occurs, document prior PD/PI and institution details as required on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification (narrative) should include Personnel (roles, percent effort, responsibilities), Mentors (roles and salary support expectations), Research Assistant duties and percent effort, Non-Personnel (analytic software, participant compensation, transcription, training/travel, conference travel), Consultant Costs (who and for what), Subcontract Costs (scope and staffing at partner organization), and Indirect costs calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the role and responsibilities of each personnel, justify requested resources (licenses, transcription, travel), describe subcontract activities and staffing, and state how indirect costs were computed and applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcontract/Subrecipient description and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification and Sections F/K — describe subcontract/subaward to Visiting Nurse Service of New York (VNSNY) including years supported, research assistant support to coordinate access to clinicians and obtain consent, programming costs to identify eligible patients, and other subcontract activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear scope of work, personnel effort, budget amounts and justification for each subcontractor; include justification for why subcontracting is necessary to achieve aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental required components
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form — Required attachments/components: Introduction (for Resubmission/Revision), Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List (for Renewal), Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research, Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring, Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s), Letters of Support from Collaborators/Contributors/Consultants, Description of Institutional Environment, Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development, Other Research Plan Sections (Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Resource Sharing, Authentication of Key Biological/Chemical Resources), Appendix (e.g., Sample Interview Guides).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble all listed components and named attachments (file names are given in the application) and ensure each required element is present, labeled, and addresses NIH expectations for career development awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission response to reviewer critiques
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Resubmission — Summarize reviewer comments (labelled R1, R2, R3), note commendations and identify addressable weaknesses; describe specific modifications (bracketed and italicized) and indicate where changes were made (e.g., RS C3). Address concerns such as publication record, scope of aims, contingency plans if Aim 1 does not generate new information, dependency of Aims 2–4 on Aim 1, sampling strategy (primary vs comorbid dementia), appropriateness of Goal Attainment Scaling (GAS) or alternative tool design, power calculations (use of validated continuous measures and clustering adjustment), recruitment feasibility and plans, training needs (clinical observations, trial design, professional development), and gaps in mentorship or expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific, point-by-point responses to reviewers, include evidence of progress (publications, pilot data), justify methodological decisions and any revisions to aims or scope, and explicitly reference where changes are made in the application narrative.
